control.title: Regulator-mandated IT governance committees and CISO independence
control.description: Run the IT Strategy Committee, IT Steering Committee and Information Security Committee at the required frequency and composition, and keep the CISO independent of the Head of IT and free of business targets, reporting cyber risk to the Board or its committee at least quarterly.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Committee charters and membership, meeting minutes, CISO appointment letter and reporting line.
acceptance_criteria: Committee charters and minutes show the required membership and meeting frequency
The CISO's appointment shows a reporting line independent of the Head of IT
Quarterly cyber risk reporting to the Board or its committee

criteria_coverage.criterion: Committee charters and minutes show the required membership and meeting frequency
The CISO's appointment shows a reporting line independent of the Head of IT
Quarterly cyber risk reporting to the Board or its committee

requirements.title: Board oversight and IT sub-committee
requirements.guidance: The Board oversees information security and cyber risk; it may delegate to a sub-committee headed by a member with security experience, meeting at least quarterly.
